_notes: Down off the roofs into the Shambles and Needle Lane. The gutter-wisp teaches Shadow, and the night starts being wrong.
Scenes 6-11 of the prologue as it was before the split; `--scene story:<index>` still counts across the whole prologue, not within this file.

scenes.art_desc: The Shambles at night: market stalls sleeping under canvas, crooked timber shopfronts, one lit lantern
lines: Between the chimneys: a thread of silver light, thin as a hair, humming. Not mine. Not hers.
Below: the Shambles. Eight bells from the tower. There is no ninth bell — there used to be.
I did not chase it. I am a professional.
Street level. The fog rolls up from the Mere, and the shadows deepen — deep enough to wear.
Something small and hungry climbs out of the gutter: a GUTTER-WISP.
Bottle-sized. It eats small lies, and it heard mine — the one about not WANTING to chase the silver thread. It has come back for seconds.

notes: ❋ SHADOW, the black energy. It hides and it wards — and in this fog it costs one less.

coach.text: Every fight opens with the going-in. STALK costs 2 Shadow and starts you unseen — or walk in and keep the cards.
This is your hand: ENERGY, not actions. You spend it to power the things you do.

text_by_approach.stalk: Two Shadow went on the entrance — that is what an approach costs, up front, out of hand. What is left is your hand: ENERGY, not actions.
text_by_approach.walk_in: You spent nothing to get in, so the hand is untouched. This is ENERGY, not actions — you feed it to the things you do.
text_by_approach.ambush: Two Ferocity went on the entrance. What is left is your hand: ENERGY, not actions.
text_by_approach.case: Two Guile went on the entrance, and it bought you a longer look. What is left is your hand: ENERGY, not actions.
text_by_approach.ward: Two Moonlight went on the entrance. What is left is your hand: ENERGY, not actions.

coach.text: Every place has a rule. In this fog, Shadow costs one less — so SLINK is free here.
Read the chip up top: it tells you the next move BEFORE it happens. Some moves take HEALTH. Some take a card out of your HAND.
SLINK: guard 3. The fog makes it free — but it has 3 USES, and uses do not come back until Ash sleeps at the Mantel. Tonight is all you get.
Three guard, until this turn ends. It will soak a bite. It will NOT stop a theft — for that, spend the card: energy already fed onto an action cannot be stolen.
POUNCE carried over from the roof with 2 uses left. Charges are a whole night's budget, not a per-fight one — they refill at the Mantel and nowhere else.
When you have nothing left worth doing, END TURN — the night moves too. Or stay: there is a free Scratch in the tray and energy in your hand. It is your turn.

lines: The wisp reconsidered its position on my honesty.
I let it keep its opinions. The night is too strange to argue with weather made of appetite.
